refusal (none)
note 2 overlapping conductor shape(s) were merged into 1 — copper that overlaps on one level is one conductor, in 3D as in the planar model.
note Port 1 ('1') at (0, 0 µm) was taken to be on the conductor's low-x (left) end (inferred from the nearest conductor boundary) of level 1 ('Metal2'), driving current in the +x direction, at 50 Ω.
note Port 1 at its line's end is a vertical lumped sheet 95 µm wide and 106 µm tall from 'Metal2' down to 'Backside Metal' (the air box's floor): as this setup names.
note Dielectric 'Passivation' is opened by 'PAD_OPEN': 1 opening(s) cut through it, 32400 µm² in all, with straight walls.
note Dielectric 'Polyimide' is opened by 'PAD_OPEN': 1 opening(s) cut through it, 32400 µm² in all, with straight walls.
note The air box's floor is 'Backside Metal' as a PEC plane at 3 µm: it is the lowest ground-reference conductor, nothing is drawn on it and nothing is drawn below it.
note 'Metal2/1' and 1 other conductor(s) are under 3 skin depths thick at 1 GHz, so Thin Metal Correction gives the faces that thickness (2.91 µm on 'Metal2/1'). Its resistance levels off at the DC value. Near two to three skin depths a line can still read up to 25 % low. A wide line close to ground can read high, because its faces carry unequal current: up to 20 % on a line 5 times wider than its height over ground, and 50 % at 50 times.
